reviews.title: Was worried until I used them. They are amazing.
reviews.comment: I was on the fence with these as they were a little more than I wanted to spend, but they were so pretty while also being reverse blade fans. My case looks AMAZING now. Any RGB program can change the lighting so it has high compatibility.
